parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Possible parameters to go in the body for the request.

host.description: The hostname/IP address of the VPN server.

port.description: The port of the VPN server.

vpn_name.description: The name of the VPN configuration.

method.description: Method to send [email|sms]. If not set, email will be the default.

email_list.description: The email address that the VPN configuration message should be sent to. Required if "method" is "email".

phone_user_list.description: The user that the VPN configuration SMS should be sent to. At least one of "phone_user_list" or "phone_number_list" is required if "method" is "sms".

phone_number_list.description: The phone number that the VPN configuration SMS should be sent to. At least one of "phone_user_list" or "phone_number_list" is required if "method" is "sms".

sms_method.description: The method to be used for sending the SMS [fortiguard|custom]. Default is "fortiguard".

sms_server.description: The SMS server to be used for sending SMS messages, required if "custom" SMS method is chosen.
